method: broad international football odds source discovery

source_decision.why: Broad international betting-edge validation needs settled results joined to pre-match 1X2 odds. The free sources found here either have results without odds, or odds limited mostly to World Cup / qualifiers.

public_csv_sources.name: football-data.co.uk World Cup workbook
public_csv_sources.coverage: World Cup finals plus World Cup qualifiers included in the current workbook
public_csv_sources.note: Preferred free source for World Cup research because it includes clean football-data-style odds columns.

public_csv_sources.name: Footiqo World Cup
public_csv_sources.note: Fallback free source available via sync-international-odds-history --provider footiqo.

public_csv_sources.name: martj42 international_results
public_csv_sources.note: Useful for team features, not sufficient for betting-edge backtests.

public_csv_sources.name: openfootball national-team datasets
public_csv_sources.coverage: World Cup, Euro, qualifiers and other national-team competitions depending on repository
public_csv_sources.data: fixtures/results in open text/CSV-like formats, no bookmaker odds
public_csv_sources.note: Good fallback for filling tournament history and team form features; not enough for edge validation without odds.

public_csv_sources.name: Kaggle/martj42 international football results
public_csv_sources.note: Same family of data as the configured martj42 CSV; useful for manual refresh checks.

public_csv_sources.name: football-data.co.uk
public_csv_sources.note: No broad national-team international CSV feed found in this project source.

public_csv_sources.name: FootyStats / public pages
public_csv_sources.coverage: selected international competitions and current-season tournament pages
public_csv_sources.data: fixtures/results and some odds-like public page fields depending on competition
public_csv_sources.note: Not a stable broad historical CSV feed for no-leakage 1X2 backtests; useful only as a manual lead.

commercial_odds_sources.name: The Odds API Historical Odds
commercial_odds_sources.coverage: international competitions returned by /v4/sports, including World Cup, Euro, Copa America and UEFA Nations League when listed
commercial_odds_sources.data: historical bookmaker odds snapshots, h2h market usable as 1X2
commercial_odds_sources.note: Best match for this project because the live odds integration already uses The Odds API.

commercial_odds_sources.name: API-Football / API-Sports
commercial_odds_sources.coverage: broad football fixtures, teams, leagues, cups and odds depending on subscription
commercial_odds_sources.note: Potential fallback provider if The Odds API historical access is not sufficient.

commercial_odds_sources.name: Sportmonks Premium Odds Feed
commercial_odds_sources.coverage: football historical pre-match odds depending on subscription
commercial_odds_sources.note: Useful only with paid premium odds access; would require a new adapter.

commercial_odds_sources.name: SportsGameOdds Historical Odds API
commercial_odds_sources.coverage: multi-sport event odds history where soccer coverage includes supported leagues/competitions
commercial_odds_sources.data: odds history API suitable for adapter research
commercial_odds_sources.note: Promising fallback when The Odds API historical plan is unavailable; must probe international soccer coverage before implementation.

odds_api.note: Use The Odds API historical endpoint for broad international 1X2 odds. Historical snapshots require a paid usage plan and start from 2020-06-06.

next_actions: Use football-data.co.uk World Cup workbook as the default free WORLD_CUP.csv source.
Keep Footiqo WORLD_CUP.csv as a fallback free World Cup odds source.
Use martj42/openfootball-style results data only for national-team feature coverage, not for betting-edge proof.
Configure THE_ODDS_API_KEY with historical access, then rerun this command to verify broad international sport keys.
If The Odds API historical access is not available, probe SportsGameOdds international soccer odds coverage before writing a second adapter.
Only after keys are verified, archive paid historical h2h snapshots and join them to settled international results.
